zh.summary: 用餐廳訂單案例理解定位、重建、驗收與交接，分清三種成功證據，讓 README 支持接手者獨立操作。
objectives: 寫出可操作的環境、命令與驗收說明。
區分預期結果、作者實測與接手者重現。
把限制、復原與清理方式納入交接。

readingGuide.goal: 寫出可操作的環境、命令與驗收說明。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 指定版本的工作坊或學員專案、新目錄與獨立環境；有同儕時使用其自有環境。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: README.md 與重現紀錄能讓接手者知道如何啟動、驗收及收工。

sections.heading: 一、先理解最重要的觀念
paragraphs:
你把一套軟體做出來，不代表別人就能接手使用。

想像你是一位廚師，研發了一道非常好吃的料理。

你自己知道要放哪些材料、使用什麼器具、烹調多久、什麼時候關火。

但如果你離職，只留下一句：

「把食材放進鍋子，煮熟就可以了。」

下一位廚師能做出同樣的料理嗎？

恐怕很難。

軟體工程也一樣。

你寫了一套程式，在自己的電腦上正常運作，但交給另一個人後，他可能不知道：

- 這套程式究竟要解決什麼問題？
- 需要安裝哪些工具和版本？
- 如何啟動？從哪個資料夾開始？
- 怎樣證明程式真的正常？
- 遇到錯誤怎麼辦？哪些功能還不能使用？
- 使用結束後，資料和服務怎麼處理？

README 就是幫助接手者回答這些問題的入口文件。 這篇教材特別強調：不只要寫操作方法，還要留下可重現的驗收證據、使用限制，以及停止和復原的方法。

sections.heading: 二、README 是什麼？它在整個專案扮演什麼角色？
paragraphs:
README 通常是一個叫做 `README.md` 的文字檔。

你可以把它想成產品隨附的「使用說明書」，但對工程專案而言，它還需要說明如何安裝、驗證和維護。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜從製作者到接手者的四階段
blocks.description: 箭頭表示文件閱讀與交付順序，不表示已通過驗收。

items.title: 定位：這是什麼？
items.body: 用途、使用對象、功能範圍、版本

items.title: 重建：怎麼讓它跑起來？
items.body: 環境、依賴套件、安裝與啟動命令

items.title: 驗收：怎麼知道它真的正常？
items.body: 測試資料、操作步驟、預期結果、實際證據

items.title: 交接：發生問題或結束使用怎麼辦？
items.body: 已知限制、錯誤處理、復原、停止、清理

paragraphs: 這四個階段可以視為交接文件的基本架構。

sections.heading: 三、用一個實際案例，把四個階段串起來
paragraphs:
假設你替一家餐廳開發了「每日訂單檢查系統」。

店長每天匯入一份 CSV 訂單檔案，系統會檢查是否有缺少訂單編號、金額異常或重複訂單。
### 第一階段：定位——這套系統究竟能做什麼？

不好的說明：

> 這是一個訂單系統，使用 Python 開發。

好的說明：

> 本系統用於檢查每日訂單 CSV 是否存在必要欄位缺漏與重複訂單。適合店長在本機處理測試資料。目前不支援多人登入、即時收銀系統串接與正式金流處理。

兩者差在哪裡？

第一個只告訴別人「這是什麼」，第二個還說清楚「能做什麼、不能做什麼，以及適合在什麼情境使用」。

尤其是「不能做什麼」非常重要。

假設餐廳老闆以為這個工具已經可以直接串接信用卡收費，可能就會做出錯誤的營運決策。
### 第二階段：重建——別人的電腦能不能重新安裝？

你在自己的電腦上可能已經安裝了幾十個 Python 套件。

但新接手的工程師拿到程式時，電腦裡什麼都沒有。

所以 README 至少應說明 Python 版本、需要的依賴套件、檔案位置，以及正確的安裝和啟動方式。

以下是示意命令：從專案根目錄開始，前提是系統已有可用的 python 命令，交付檔案包含 requirements.txt、pytest 測試與可直接執行的 app.py。這組命令與後面的 Streamlit 工作坊範例屬於不同專案。

blocks.heading: 程式與指令 1
paragraphs: 示意命令，使用前先核對本節前提。
blocks.code:
# 建立獨立的 Python 環境
python -m venv .venv

# 在 Linux/macOS 啟用
source .venv/bin/activate

# 安裝專案依賴
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

# 執行測試
python -m pytest -q

# 啟動程式（假設入口為 app.py）
python app.py

paragraphs:
這裡要理解兩個重要觀念。

第一，不能只寫「執行 app.py」。 別人還需要知道前置環境、路徑和依賴條件。

第二，最好使用乾淨環境（Clean Environment）驗證。

乾淨環境就像一個新廚房，沒有你平常使用的特殊工具或已經準備好的食材。

如果這套系統只能在你自己的電腦執行，可能表示你遺漏了某些安裝條件。當然，乾淨環境成功不代表所有作業系統都相容，這仍要分別測試。
### 第三階段：驗收——程式跑起來就代表成功嗎？

不一定。

假設你的訂單檢查程式成功開啟，但遇到重複訂單時沒有提出警告，那就沒有達到原本的目的。

因此我們必須定義「成功應該長什麼樣子」。

blocks.caption: 表 1
rows: 顯示明確錯誤，不應當機

paragraphs:
這張表屬於預期行為，不是已經通過測試的證據。

真正測試時，還需要記下測試日期、程式版本、輸入資料、實際結果，以及成功或失敗。

這就是軟體工程裡非常重要的區別：

「我認為應該成功」不等於「我已經證明它成功」。
### 第四階段：交接——發生問題、停止使用時怎麼辦？

假設餐廳店長在使用軟體時，突然發現某筆訂單金額錯誤。

README 應清楚交代，能否撤銷、是否需要重新匯入、哪些紀錄要保留，以及如何安全停止程式。

另外，如果這只是單機原型，也不能因為現在可以使用，就認為把服務開放給所有分店便能直接正式營運。

多人使用可能涉及身分驗證、存取權限、資料保存、備份和維護等新問題。

交接的目的，不是保證軟體完全沒有問題，而是讓接手者知道問題的邊界，並有能力作出下一步判斷。

sections.heading: 四、最容易忽略的三種「成功」
paragraphs: 交接紀錄需要區分三種不同的證據。

blocks.caption: 表 2
rows: 在這次環境與條件下成功
我在全新資料夾與環境重新安裝
減少了對原環境的依賴
別人只依照文件完成操作
文件更有可能真正支援交接

paragraphs:
想像你是一位老師。

你自己能解開一道數學題，代表你會做。

你重新解了一次，代表你能重現自己的方法。

但如果你寫的解題說明讓另一個學生不需詢問就能理解並解出來，才更能證明你的說明具有可傳遞性。

這也是為什麼 README 不能只是作者自己的筆記。

sections.heading: 五、放到其他行業，這個觀念一樣成立
paragraphs: ### 醫療：儀器與檢驗程序交接
新進檢驗人員不只需要知道儀器的開關在哪裡，還需要知道校正程序、操作條件、品質控制、異常警示及停止使用的標準。
### 製造業：產線設備交接
一台設備今天能正常運轉，不代表新人能安全操作。必須交代設定參數、正常範圍、異常停機條件與復原程序。
### AI 系統：模型與 Agent 專案交接

不能只留下模型權重或原始碼。還要說明模型版本、推論環境、工具權限、測試資料、評估結果與已知失敗情境，尤其不能把實驗成功誤認為正式環境安全。

這些例子說明文件交接原理，實際儀器操作仍須依專屬程序執行。這些例子的共同原理，就是把個人腦中的隱性知識，轉換成其他人能遵循、檢查和驗證的操作資訊。

sections.heading: 六、什麼才算一份合格的 README？
paragraphs: 你可以使用以下八項清單檢查自己的文件。勾選表示自己的盤點進度，計數不代表驗收結果。

blocks.caption: 圖 2｜交接完成度自我檢查
blocks.description: 勾選只表示文件盤點；0 / 8 是初始狀態，不代表軟體品質、正式驗收或獨立交接通過。

items.title: 說明專案用途、使用對象與適用範圍
列出需要的作業系統、軟體版本與依賴
提供正確的安裝、測試與啟動命令
提供測試資料、預期結果與實測紀錄
清楚區分已驗證功能和未驗證事項
記錄已知限制、風險與不能使用的情境
說明錯誤處理、停止服務與資料清理
讓另一個人從乾淨環境獨立重現

paragraphs:
這份清單是文件完整度的初步檢查，並不代表勾選後就已證明軟體品質或安全性。接手者獨立重現仍須保留其實際環境、操作、獲得的協助與結果。

還有一個重要原則：當程式碼、依賴套件、啟動方式或輸出規格改變時，README 與驗收證據也應同步更新。

sections.heading: 七、最後用一個情境確認是否真正理解
paragraphs:
假設你為學校開發了一套 AI 論文摘要系統。

你已經完成程式，並在自己的電腦成功產生 100 篇論文摘要。

你把 GitHub 儲存庫交給一位新加入的研究助理，README 只有：

blocks.heading: 程式與指令 2
paragraphs: 示意命令，使用前先核對本節前提。
blocks.code:
1. 安裝 Python
2. 執行 main.py
3. 開啟瀏覽器使用

paragraphs:
請回答以下三題，先不用追求標準措辭：

1. 這份 README 至少缺少哪四種重要資訊？
2. 如果研究助理無法執行，但你自己可以，該如何判斷究竟是環境問題、程式問題，還是交接文件問題？
3. 如果研究助理成功產出摘要，是否就能宣稱這套 AI 已經適合醫院或銀行正式使用？為什麼？

本篇最重要的結論：

寫程式，是讓機器能夠執行；寫好 README、驗收證據與交接文件，是讓其他人能夠理解、重建、驗證並負責任地使用這套系統。

真正的工程交付，不只是把作品交出去，而是讓作品不再依賴原作者才能繼續運作。

sections.heading: 延伸操作｜既有工作坊重現範例
paragraphs: 以下是既有 Streamlit 工作坊的實際目錄與命令，與餐廳 CSV 示意專案分開使用。只在取得指定版本資源包後依序核對。

blocks.heading: README.md｜工作坊重現範例
paragraphs: 命令逐條執行；Windows 啟用方式另依說明，未經實測的平台保留待驗。
blocks.code:
# 合成收件資料完整性檢核｜工作坊重現範例

## 用途與範圍
本機單人、只用合成資料；檢查申請編號、申請人代號、文件類型。
去除首尾空白後為 1–80 字元。完整僅代表教學欄位，不代表正式受理。
沒有登入、多人授權、持久資料庫、外部 API 或正式部署。

## 環境與檔案
Python 3.11／3.12；依 requirements.txt 安裝固定直接依賴。
Streamlit 1.51.0、pytest 8.4.2；未宣稱所有間接依賴鎖定。
在解壓根目錄可見 requirements.txt、starter/、slices/、reference/。

## 建立環境（POSIX shell，從解壓根目錄）
python3 -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python --version
python -m streamlit version
python -m pytest --version

## 測試及啟動參考解答
cd reference
python -m pytest -q
python -m streamlit run app.py --server.address 127.0.0.1
瀏覽器開啟終端機顯示的本機網址；Ctrl+C 停止服務。
Windows PowerShell 從解壓根目錄啟用的命令為 .venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1；依既有政策操作。

## 最小操作驗收
填 SYN-001、DEMO-A，文件類型空白時按檢查：提示缺漏，無完整下載。
補上「合成申請表」再檢查：可預覽及下載 JSON。
清空文件類型並提交變更：舊成功與下載失效，補值後需重查。
讀取下載檔，核對三欄、status、scope 與中文內容。

## 結果、限制與清理
另記實際日期、平台、版本、命令、退出結果與尚未執行項目。
AppTest 不取代真實瀏覽器下載或真人任務觀察。
下載檔在操作者裝置，關閉頁面不代表已刪除。
結束後停止本次服務，依需要保留或刪除合成下載。
多人版需先確認身分、授權、儲存與維運要求，再設計及驗證。

sections.heading: 停止、復原與下一個決策
paragraphs: 寫明單人本機、合成資料、沒有登入與多人授權、沒有持久資料庫或正式部署。若要十人共用，下一步先確認資料存取、保存、備份與維運，不只換一個啟動位址。
出錯時說明先停止哪個服務、保存哪些紀錄與如何回到已知版本；下載檔在裝置上另行管理。不要宣稱關閉網頁就安全刪除所有資料。

exercise.environment: 指定版本的工作坊或學員專案、新目錄與獨立環境；有同儕時使用其自有環境。
steps: 依範例改寫 README，使路徑、依賴與實際交付一致。
從新目錄重建、測試、啟動並完成缺漏、補正與變更驗收，記錄需要協助之處。
補齊限制、停止與復原資訊；分開標記作者重建與真人交接。
exercise.expected: README.md 與重現紀錄能讓接手者知道如何啟動、驗收及收工。
exercise.check: 不複製既有虛擬環境，不把預期輸出或作者重建當成同儕實測。
exercise.cleanup: 停止本次啟動的服務，保留合成作品、Diff 與實際結果；不要覆蓋其他工作或留下真實資料。

openChecks.prompt: 這份 README 至少缺少哪四種重要資訊？
answer: 至少補上用途與範圍、環境及版本、依賴與起始目錄、安裝及啟動命令、測試資料與預期結果、實測紀錄、已知限制、停止與復原。依實際交付核對，不靠作者記憶。

openChecks.prompt: 如果研究助理無法執行，但你自己可以，該如何判斷究竟是環境問題、程式問題，還是交接文件問題？
answer: 先固定同一程式版本與合成輸入，記錄兩邊平台、Python／套件版本、工作目錄、命令與完整錯誤。從新目錄依 README 重建；若缺了安裝或路徑說明就補文件，若相同條件仍輸出錯誤就調查程式。保留獲協助處，修正後重跑，才能縮小原因，不能只憑作者能跑就斷言。

openChecks.prompt: 如果研究助理成功產出摘要，是否就能宣稱這套 AI 已經適合醫院或銀行正式使用？為什麼？
answer: 不能。產出摘要只證明該次功能情境；摘要品質、隱私、權限、安全、維運與目標領域驗收各需相應證據。100 篇作者實測與另一人成功重現也不能代填這些驗證。

en.summary: Use a restaurant order example to locate, rebuild, accept and hand over a project, separating three evidence layers so README supports independent operation.
objectives: Write actionable environment, command and acceptance instructions.
Separate expected results, author checks and successor reproduction.
Include limitations, recovery and cleanup in handoff.

readingGuide.goal: Write actionable environment, command and acceptance instructions.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A specified workshop/project version, a new directory and separate environment; a peer uses their own environment when available.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: README.md and reproduction records explaining startup, acceptance and shutdown.

sections.heading: 1. Understand the central idea
paragraphs:
Making software work does not automatically let someone else take it over.

Imagine a chef who develops a delicious dish. The chef knows the ingredients, equipment, cooking time and when to turn off the heat. On leaving, the chef writes only: “Put the ingredients in the pot and cook them.” Could the next chef reliably reproduce the dish? The missing conditions make that difficult.

Software has the same problem. Your program runs on your computer, but its recipient may still need answers:

- What problem does the software solve?
- Which tools and versions must be installed?
- How do I start it, and from which directory?
- How can I demonstrate that it works correctly?
- What should I do about errors, and which features remain unavailable?
- How should I manage data and services after use?

README is the entry document for those questions. Alongside operating instructions, retain reproducible acceptance evidence, limitations, and shutdown and recovery procedures.

sections.heading: 2. What is README, and where does it fit?
paragraphs: README is usually a text file named `README.md`. Think of a product's instruction manual, expanded to explain installation, verification and maintenance for an engineering project.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Four Stages from Maker to Successor
blocks.description: Arrows show the reading and delivery sequence, not passed acceptance.

items.title: Locate: what is it?
items.body: Purpose, intended users, scope and version

items.title: Rebuild: how do I run it?
items.body: Environment, dependencies, installation and startup commands

items.title: Accept: how do I know it works?
items.body: Test data, steps, expected results and actual evidence

items.title: Hand over: what about failures or shutdown?
items.body: Known limits, error handling, recovery, shutdown and cleanup

paragraphs: The four stages organize a handoff: locate the purpose, users, scope and version; rebuild with the environment, dependencies and installation/startup commands; accept with test data, steps, expectations and actual evidence; and hand over with known limits, error handling, recovery, shutdown and cleanup. The arrows show the document's operating route, not evidence that any stage has passed.

sections.heading: 3. Connect the stages through a restaurant example
paragraphs: Suppose you develop a Daily Order Checker for a restaurant. Each day, the manager imports a CSV file, and the system checks for missing order IDs, unusual amounts or duplicate orders.
### Stage 1: Locate — what can the system do?

A weak description:

> This is an order system written in Python.

A more useful description:

> This system checks daily order CSV files for missing required fields and duplicate orders. Restaurant managers can use it locally with test data. It currently does not support multiuser login, live point-of-sale integration or production payment processing.

The first description identifies the software. The second also explains capabilities, exclusions and intended use. If the owner assumes that the checker can charge credit cards, that misunderstanding can lead to an incorrect operating decision. Explicit exclusions help the recipient make an appropriate decision.
### Stage 2: Rebuild — can another computer install it?

Your computer may already contain dozens of Python packages. The new engineer may start with none. README therefore needs the Python version, dependencies, file locations and correct installation and startup instructions.

The following commands are illustrative. Start at the project root with a working `python` command, a delivered `requirements.txt`, pytest tests, and a directly executable `app.py`. They do not describe the separate Streamlit workshop package.

blocks.heading: Code 1
paragraphs: Illustrative commands; use the prerequisites stated above.
blocks.code:
# 建立獨立的 Python 環境
python -m venv .venv

# 在 Linux/macOS 啟用
source .venv/bin/activate

# 安裝專案依賴
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

# 執行測試
python -m pytest -q

# 啟動程式（假設入口為 app.py）
python app.py

paragraphs:
Two ideas matter here. “Run app.py” alone leaves out the prerequisites, paths and dependencies. A clean environment also helps reveal these assumptions: it is like a new kitchen without the special tools and prepared ingredients you normally use.

If the program works only on your computer, installation conditions may be missing. Success in one clean environment still does not establish compatibility with every operating system; test each claimed platform separately.
### Stage 3: Accept — does opening the program establish success?
No. If the checker opens but fails to warn about duplicate orders, it has not met its purpose. Define observable success first.

blocks.caption: Table 1
rows: Use the same ID for two orders
Display a clear error without crashing
Correct an error and check again

paragraphs: These are expectations, not evidence of passed tests. When testing, record the date, program version, input data, actual result, and pass or fail. “I expect success” and “I demonstrated success under these conditions” support different claims.
### Stage 4: Hand over — what happens on failure or after use?

Suppose the manager notices an incorrect order amount. README should explain whether it can be undone, whether reimport is needed, which records to retain, and how to stop the program safely.

A working local prototype also needs further decisions before all branches can use it in production. Shared use can introduce authentication, access permissions, retention, backup and maintenance requirements. Handoff gives the recipient enough information about these boundaries to decide what to do next; it does not guarantee the absence of defects.

sections.heading: 4. Three different kinds of success
paragraphs: Separate these evidence layers in the handoff record.

blocks.caption: Table 2
rows: I ran it in my own environment
Success under this run's environment and conditions
I reinstalled in a new directory and environment
Reduced dependence on the original environment
Another person operated it using only the instructions
Stronger evidence that the document supports handoff

paragraphs: Imagine teaching a mathematical problem. Solving it yourself shows that you can do it. Solving it again demonstrates that you can reproduce your method. If another student can understand your written explanation and solve it without asking you, that provides stronger evidence that your explanation transfers the knowledge. README likewise needs to serve someone beyond its author.

sections.heading: 5. The same documentation principle in other industries
paragraphs: ### Healthcare: instrument and laboratory-procedure handoff

New laboratory personnel need more than the power switch location. Documentation also identifies calibration procedures, operating conditions, quality controls, abnormal alerts and criteria for stopping use.
### Manufacturing: production-equipment handoff
A machine running today does not establish that a newcomer can operate it safely. Handoff includes settings, normal ranges, abnormal-stop conditions and recovery procedures.
### AI systems: model and Agent project handoff

Weights and source code alone leave out model versions, inference environments, tool permissions, test data, evaluation results and known failure scenarios. Experimental success does not establish production safety.

These are analogies about documentation, not instrument-specific operating instructions. Their shared principle is to turn knowledge in one person's head into information another person can follow, inspect and verify.

sections.heading: 6. What makes a usable README?
paragraphs: Use the following eight-item self-check to inspect your document. Each checkbox marks your own review of an item; the count is not an acceptance result.

blocks.caption: Figure 2 | Handoff Document Self-check
blocks.description: Selections track document review only. The initial 0 / 8 is not software quality, production acceptance or passed independent handoff.

items.title: Explain purpose, intended users and scope
List required operating systems, versions and dependencies
Provide correct install, test and startup commands
Provide test data, expected results and execution records
Separate verified features from unverified items
Record known limits, risks and excluded uses
Explain error handling, shutdown and data cleanup
Have another person reproduce it independently in a clean environment

paragraphs:
This is an initial document-completeness check. Selecting every item does not demonstrate software quality or safety. For independent reproduction, retain the successor's actual environment, actions, assistance and result rather than relying on the checkbox.

Whenever code, dependencies, startup instructions or output specifications change, update README and the relevant acceptance evidence together.

sections.heading: 7. Check your understanding with a scenario
paragraphs: You develop an AI paper-summary system for a school and successfully generate summaries of 100 papers on your computer. You give the GitHub repository to a new research assistant, but README contains only:

blocks.heading: Code 2
paragraphs: Illustrative commands; use the prerequisites stated above.
blocks.code:
1. 安裝 Python
2. 執行 main.py
3. 開啟瀏覽器使用

paragraphs:
Answer these three questions in your own words:

1. Which four or more important kinds of information are missing from this README?
2. If the assistant cannot run the system but you can, how would you investigate an environment issue, a program issue or a handoff-document issue?
3. If the assistant successfully generates summaries, can you claim the AI is ready for production in hospitals or banks? Why?

Writing software gives the machine instructions to execute. README, acceptance evidence and handoff documentation let other people understand, rebuild, verify and use it responsibly. Engineering delivery allows the work to continue without depending on the original author.

sections.heading: Further Practice | Reproduce the Existing Workshop
paragraphs: The following directories and commands belong to the existing Streamlit workshop, separate from the illustrative restaurant CSV project. Use them only with the specified resource-package version.

blocks.heading: README.md | Workshop Reproduction Example
paragraphs: Execute commands individually; follow the separate Windows activation instructions and leave untested platforms pending. The unchanged Traditional Chinese example covers local single-user synthetic input, three trimmed 1–80-character fields and no official acceptance; absent login/multiuser/database/API/deployment; Python 3.11/3.12 with Streamlit 1.51.0/pytest 8.4.2; root directories; a new venv and installation; reference tests/startup and Ctrl+C; omission, correction, change invalidation and JSON inspection; actual version/result records, separate human checks, device downloads and future shared-version decisions.
blocks.code:
# 合成收件資料完整性檢核｜工作坊重現範例

## 用途與範圍
本機單人、只用合成資料；檢查申請編號、申請人代號、文件類型。
去除首尾空白後為 1–80 字元。完整僅代表教學欄位，不代表正式受理。
沒有登入、多人授權、持久資料庫、外部 API 或正式部署。

## 環境與檔案
Python 3.11／3.12；依 requirements.txt 安裝固定直接依賴。
Streamlit 1.51.0、pytest 8.4.2；未宣稱所有間接依賴鎖定。
在解壓根目錄可見 requirements.txt、starter/、slices/、reference/。

## 建立環境（POSIX shell，從解壓根目錄）
python3 -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python --version
python -m streamlit version
python -m pytest --version

## 測試及啟動參考解答
cd reference
python -m pytest -q
python -m streamlit run app.py --server.address 127.0.0.1
瀏覽器開啟終端機顯示的本機網址；Ctrl+C 停止服務。
Windows PowerShell 從解壓根目錄啟用的命令為 .venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1；依既有政策操作。

## 最小操作驗收
填 SYN-001、DEMO-A，文件類型空白時按檢查：提示缺漏，無完整下載。
補上「合成申請表」再檢查：可預覽及下載 JSON。
清空文件類型並提交變更：舊成功與下載失效，補值後需重查。
讀取下載檔，核對三欄、status、scope 與中文內容。

## 結果、限制與清理
另記實際日期、平台、版本、命令、退出結果與尚未執行項目。
AppTest 不取代真實瀏覽器下載或真人任務觀察。
下載檔在操作者裝置，關閉頁面不代表已刪除。
結束後停止本次服務，依需要保留或刪除合成下載。
多人版需先確認身分、授權、儲存與維運要求，再設計及驗證。

sections.heading: Shutdown, Recovery and the Next Decision
paragraphs: State local single-user execution, synthetic data, absent login/multiuser authorization, no persistent database and no production deployment. For ten users, first address access, retention, backup and operations rather than only changing the bind address.

Explain which service to stop on failure, which records to retain and how to recover a known version. Downloaded files are managed separately on the device; closing the page does not securely erase all data.

exercise.environment: A specified workshop/project version, a new directory and separate environment; a peer uses their own environment when available.
steps: Adapt README so paths and dependencies match actual delivery.
Rebuild, test and start in a new directory; perform omission, correction and change acceptance and record assistance needed.
Complete limitations, shutdown and recovery information, separating author reproduction from human handoff.
exercise.expected: README.md and reproduction records explaining startup, acceptance and shutdown.
exercise.check: Copy no existing virtual environment. Expected output or author reproduction is not peer execution.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

openChecks.prompt: Which four or more important kinds of information are missing from this README?
answer: Include at least purpose and scope, environment and versions, dependencies and starting directory, install/startup commands, test data and expectations, execution evidence, known limits, shutdown and recovery. Match actual delivery rather than author memory.

openChecks.prompt: If the assistant cannot run it but you can, how would you investigate environment, program and handoff-document issues?
answer: Fix the same program version and synthetic input. Record platforms, Python/package versions, working directories, commands and complete errors. Rebuild from a new directory using README. Correct missing installation/path instructions; investigate the program if the same conditions still produce wrong output. Retain assistance and rerun after changes to narrow the cause. Author success alone does not establish the diagnosis.

openChecks.prompt: If the assistant generates summaries successfully, can the AI be declared ready for production in hospitals or banks? Why?
answer: No. Producing summaries supports only the tested functional scenario. Summary quality, privacy, permissions, security, operations and domain-specific acceptance require their own evidence. Neither 100 author-generated summaries nor successful successor reproduction fills those gaps.

zh.prompt: README 的命令應以什麼為準？
options: 實際交付的版本與目錄結構
The version and directory structure actually delivered.
rationales: Dependencies and starting location are also needed.

zh.prompt: 作者在新環境重建成功，可以記成什麼？
options: 作者重建成功，同儕交接仍待驗
rationales: 不是另一位讀者的證據。

en.prompt: The author rebuilt successfully in a new environment. What may be recorded?
options: Author reproduction succeeded; peer handoff remains pending.
A production multiuser service is ready.
rationales: That is not evidence from another reader.
Preserve the actual actor and scope.

zh.prompt: 為何要寫停止與下載清理方式？
options: 交接包含執行後資源與檔案的管理
rationales: 仍需真實刪除機制與證據。
知道服務與資料各由誰管理。

en.prompt: Why document shutdown and download cleanup?
options: Handoff includes managing resources and files after execution.
rationales: Actual deletion mechanisms/evidence are still needed.
They are part of the operation.
Identify responsibility for services and data.
